verdict.rationale: Adyen's documented risk system, Protect, provides machine-learning fraud detection trained on global transaction data. It also offers a rule builder for creating, backtesting and labeling custom rules, and every payment's risk evaluation resolves to a block, allow, or review action. missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-transaction fraud score visibility to finance-ops users, in-depth rule-builder docs beyond feature-list snippets, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can screen transactions with machine-learning fraud scores and write custom block, review, and allow rules

citations.quote: You can detect, monitor, and mitigate fraud using Protect, Adyen's risk management system.
Create, backtest, and label custom rules with a rule builder interface | Machine learning powered fraud detection using global transaction data
Each payment goes through a risk evaluation. The risk evaluation reaches a decision that results in an action to block, allow, or review the transaction.
